canonical_edition: M. L. West (ed.), Iambi et elegi Graeci, vol. 2 (Clarendon, 1972), pp.83–90; Q 598: elegiac/iambic fragments 1–9, 11–12, 13a–17, 22, 24–26.
sources_tested: Perseus Catalog work record tlg0255.tlg001 and its edition records; Perseus Edmonds page; Commons file record and its PDM declaration; temporary visual samples from the 1826 Bachius scan (pp.4, 14, 38 printed) on 2026-08-12. No provider OCR was used.
open_text_result: Perseus catalog confirms exactly TLG 0255.001 Fragmenta (610 words), but its online Edmonds page is English translation and no Greek open-text rendition of the full West 1972 fragment set was verified. The modern West edition is catalogued but not openly licensed.
open_text_license: No reusable Greek full-text licence verified for the Canon's West 1972 edition. Perseus online Edmonds page is CC BY-SA 3.0 US but is translation-facing, not the requested Greek text.
scan_result: A complete alternate Greek edition is available as a legible PDM scan: N. Bachius, Mimnermi Colophonii Carminum quae supersunt (1826), 85-page PDF. Visual samples show printed Greek (including the Mimnermus/AG 9.50 distichon on printed p.38).
scan_rights: Wikimedia Commons declares the full 1826 scan Public Domain Mark 1.0 / free of known copyright restrictions.
